notes.title: Update 1.06 - Track and Wheel
notes.notes:
Changes in Update 1.06

 New custom wheels for vehicles.
 Drift track surface remade for smoother transitions.
 Model optimisation on main time trial tracks.
 New UI for vehicle customisation.
 Vehicle tuning now visually represented.
Vehicle Liveries reskinned to fit properly.


Important Note!

Some players might experience difficulty with the new customisation not showing up on vehicles.
In the case of this happening delete the following files from the saved game folder. 
!THIS WILL RESET VEHICLE SETUPS!

Location:...steamapps\common\Redline Racing\RedLineRacing\Saved\SaveGames

Files:

 SG_Bronco
 SG_C46
 SG_Centaur
 SG_GTAero
 SG_R3
 SG_Stella
 SG_V10

notes.title: Update 21/10/2023 : Quality of Life
notes.notes:
Improvements:

 Vehicle weight increase (More Grounded)
 Foam block destruction and collision changed so they will no longer upset the vehicle.
 Menu music can now be completely muted
 Car unlock values highlighted to be easier to identify
 Vehicle rumbling feedback fixed and now increases with the drift angle and disables after drift.
 Vehicle Paint now has a visual application and sound
Minor UI changes


Notes:
Some checkpoints still cause spawn issues when resetting vehicles.
This will be fixed in the next update.

notes.title: Drift Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44489536/b19afe503d53cffc55130fb2518c09d4166a0770.jpg

Drift Update: 19/10/2023

After much needed feedback from players we have completely reworked the vehicle handling mechanics.

Improvements:

 Vehicle physics and drivetrain redone
 Drift capabilities added to vehicles
 All new torque curves created
 Vehicle engine rework
 Vehicle more manoeuvrable and responsive
Time penalties removed and replaced with drift score penalties
Drift multiplier added
Vehicle sound updates


Removed:

 Vehicle Upgrades temporarily removed


Notes:
Vehicle upgrades will return with a new interface to allow players to adjust their vehicle setup

notes.title: Update Notes: 14/10/2023
notes.notes:
Vehicles:

All vehicle tyre models has been updated to give a more controlled feeling. 

This will reduce the possibility for the vehicles to snap and spin out. 

Vehicle Engines and torque curves have been adjusted as well to simulate more accurate engines.

First time players will now be greeted with a tutorial before they are able to continue playing. 
This will only happen once.
